note: InteractionResult's constant fields changed descriptor in 1.21.4: they are still class_1269 constants from the source's point of view, but the target declares them as record subtypes. JVMS 5.4.3.2 resolves a field by name AND descriptor, so the old GETSTATIC fails with NoSuchFieldError even though the value would be assignable (measured in JvmResolutionTest, runs/p255). Each rule redirects one field read to an accessor that re-widens the target field to class_1269.
